etymology: English: a chat that is also a group, which is the whole problem.
carriers: The family thread, the neighbours' thread, the school parents' thread, and the one with the uncle.
economics: Free, which is why it is where the forward lives and the correction never arrives.
signature: A screenshot, a forward, and no link.

confused_with.tell: The comment section is public and adversarial; the group chat is private and trusting. Same fallacies, opposite selection pressure.

senses: A private, high-trust, low-correction forum - the room where a claim arrives from someone you love and is therefore not audited.
It exploits trust rather than speed. Nobody fact-checks their aunt, so the habitat runs almost entirely on Appeals to Authority and Pity, and the correction that would fix it never gets forwarded.
example: *"Three forwards before breakfast: one about a bank, one about a vaccine, one about a school - all from the same uncle, none with a link."*
counter: The screenshot, sent to the whole chat. A group where nothing can be quoted is a group where a rumour can live indefinitely.
